% A pgfkeys key whose name holds unknown text (\U is stubbed: any text
% without control sequences). pgfkeys splits the key at its slashes and
% strips the path's last one with `#1/\relax`. For no such text does TeX
% put `\relax` into a key name.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgfkeys}
\usepackage{unknowntext}
\edef\t{\U}
\pgfkeys{/tcb/.unknown/.code={}}
\pgfkeys{/tcb/skin@\t}
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\begin{document}
\end{document}
